Nitrogen controls cover fused, biaryl, amino-nitrile, and donor-bearing topologies at contrasting ratios. Carbonyl and polyacceptor selections form local condition and loading curves around m25, m26, m28, m78, m114, m159, and m178, where delayed finishes are plausible and model intervals are broad. Four m72 points insert intermediate ratio, solvent, and loading conditions into the existing nonlinear response series. Donor-bearing and neutral high-ratio controls test transfer beyond the original scaffolds. The anchors constrain the common aromatic, ester, ether, and hydrophobic regime so that repairs for rare late rows do not shift the dominant portion of the Row-distribution."}
